spatial_correspondence.criterion: reference and CS_C1 in both designs at both grids; each primary IR Spearman >=0.5

decision.temporal_limit: activity-derived averaged power and static VDD IR; no transient or thermal validation

external_question: What is the practical impact of the 2.4% reduction? Does this translate in IR-drop or thermal hotspot improvement?

smoke_qualification.invalidation_reason: Earlier locally complete attempts predate shared-qualified ingestion/parser/source implementation; attempt4 masks frozen nonclock activity. Source mismatch excludes all provisional attempts. Original receipts remain preserved.
